title: Introduction to File System Module
overview: The File System (fs) module in Node.js allows applications to interact with files and folders such as reading, writing, updating, and deleting files.

title: Reading Files
overview: Node.js provides methods to read file content from the system using the fs module.

title: Writing Files
overview: The fs module allows creating new files or replacing existing file content using write methods.

title: Updating and Deleting Files
overview: Node.js can modify existing files and remove files using methods provided by the fs module.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how Node.js interacts with files using the File System module including reading, writing, updating, and deleting files.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ fs handles file operations.
✔ readFile() reads files.
✔ writeFile() creates or updates files.
✔ unlink() deletes files.
